answer: Picture honest agents as a reef: each must anchor a costly, non-refundable compute bond before it can trade. A sybil swarm cannot echo that bond cheaply, since spinning up a thousand sable-cloaked clones means posting the bond a thousand separate times, and any clone caught colluding is slashed. The attacker cost scales linearly with the number of fake identities, so buying a voting majority becomes economically ruinous instead of nearly free.
